verdict.rationale:
Gusto's payroll runs and contractor_payment_groups inherently act across many employees/contractors at once (docs-27, docs-44, docs-61), and the official CLI/agent skills (payroll-prep, timesheet-sync) drive per-cycle payroll prep across a whole company in one agent session, giving some multi-item automation depth. However there's no documented bulk/batch API endpoint for creating, updating, or approving many discrete records (e.g., employees, time-off requests) in a single call — operations like time-off approvals and employee onboarding are described one-at-a-time.
missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch create-update-approve endpoints for arbitrary item sets, CLI commands that operate on multiple named items in a single invocation, independent evidence of large-scale bulk automation in practice.
